data.name: React jS
data.full_description:
Learn React.js from scratch and build modern, responsive, and dynamic web applications. This course covers React fundamentals, components, hooks, routing, state management, API integration, authentication, and deployment through practical projects and real-world examples.
Course Syllabus

Introduction to React & Setup
JSX and Components
Props and State
Event Handling
React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useRef)
Forms and Validation
React Router
API Integration (Fetch & Axios)
Context API & State Management
Authentication & Protected Routes
Performance Optimization
Project Structure & Best Practices
Deployment (Vercel & Netlify)

Projects

Todo Application
E-Commerce Frontend
Admin Dashboard

Duration: 6–8 WeeksLevel: Beginner to IntermediateCertificate: Provided upon completion.
